weight_file_layout_observed_live: IMPORTANT CORRECTION vs. the model_identity evidence's HF-index-based figure, consistent across BOTH attempts: the live execution logs show vLLM loading the model via 7 files ('Parse safetensors files: 0/7'...'Loading safetensors checkpoint shards: 7/7', with the log line 'Inferred from consolidated*.safetensors files torch.bfloat16 dtype'), NOT the 3-shard model-0000X-of-00003.safetensors layout described by the repository's model.safetensors.index.json.
